children.text: A small thought. A whole possibility.

A whole world
from one idea.

Give every beat
a reason to move.
The voice gives the scene its rhythm.
A little colour. A different feeling.
Every story begins with an idea
Rachana turns that idea into motion
This smaller circle is the Moon
Their positions change but the explanation stays connected to the voice
Each visual follows an editable timing anchor
Change the colors adjust a reveal and render again
